- BLOCKED: No way to inspect the Measure ground truth beyond single scalar calls, and no canonical evaluator was registered (the setup notice asked for generators/registration.json). I did not register one, so evaluations never reached the canonical store and the run had no reproducible ground-truth record. I should have written that registration or flagged the gap before spending the budget.
- BLOCKER: The run closed UNGATED, most likely because no canonical ground-truth source was registered, so the success criteria could not be verified against stored evaluations.
- FRICTION: ReportEvals first failed on a wrong parameter name (args instead of count); corrected on retry. The Measure budget (30) allowed only 2-3 replicates per x-region, so the sd model is rough. Deliverable: predict.py at car_tool/predict.py with mu=0.1000x^2+1.3327x+1.4905 and sd=3.286+0.04297*mu; 93% in-sample coverage.
